rendered: The paper does not conclude that aqueous processing is incompatible with Ni-rich NMC 811. In fact, it states that "pouch cells made with aqueous-processed NMC 811 still demonstrate very good electrochemical performance" (page 5). The paper does mention that lithium leaching occurs, but notes that even Ni-rich NMC 811 shows only minimal Li^þ leaching (~3 wt%) after one week.
